text:
IncidentBot: [alert] Cedarline production - repeated 503s on inference route /v1/generate  (count: 42 in last 12h)
Maria (CS): Hi team — Cedarline saw another cluster of 503s this morning. Customer is pushing higher qps. Need to confirm owners for remediation items.
Olivia - AM: Thanks Maria. Cedarline is on net-new onboarding plan; they've paused rollout if we don't have ETA. Please prioritize.
Jake SRE: looking... I see spikes aligned with a retry storm at 03:10 UTC. Dump attach:
Jake SRE: ```
2026-05-05T03:10:12Z ERROR proxy: upstream 10.12.4.7 timed out status=503 route=/v1/generate seq=... 
``` 
Liam (Eng): That stacktrace points to the new KV cache eviction loop regressing under burst load. I can push a quick patch to throttle eviction policy, but need an owner to run canary.
Maria (CS): Liam — can you own the patch? Jake can do the canary and monitor. I'll tell Cedarline the timeline.
Liam (Eng): I can own the patch. ETA 2h to build + 1h for canary. Will open PR and tag @Jake SRE
Jake SRE: Happy to run the canary. I'll take the 1h window starting 06:30 UTC and monitor latency/errors and cost delta.
Olivia - AM: Please note Cedarline flagged increased spend due to retries — include a spending estimate in the update.
Maria (CS): Action items: 1) Liam patch & PR (owner: Liam) 2) Canary + watch (owner: Jake) 3) Spend estimate + customer update (owner: Olivia) 4) Postmortem draft (owner: Maria). Anyone want to adjust?
Liam (Eng): Confirmed. PR will reference: INF-2376. I will add rollout rollback hook.
Jake SRE: I'll post canary metrics to #eng-monitoring and ping this thread with results.
Maria (CS): Customer-facing update I'll send at 07:45 UTC unless any blockers. Olivia, want to add anything on the renewal risk side?
Olivia - AM: If canary succeeds and spend delta < 12%, we keep timeline. Otherwise we need a 1:1 with finance. I'll prepare a brief.
IncidentBot: Incident assigned -> cedarline-503-repeat, severity=high, owners=[Liam (Eng), Jake SRE], sla=24h
Maria (CS): Thanks all. I'll follow up with timestamps and the customer note. :thumbsup:
Jake SRE: quick note — temporary mitigation: reducing max_concurrent_requests to 60 reduced 503s in staging.
Liam (Eng): Good catch. I'll include that as a soft fallback in the patch.
Maria (CS): Closing for now — will reopen thread with canary results. /cc @Olivia - AM
